one_line_description: Shopify AI Toolkit provides a set of tools for building agentic shopping experiences and interacting with Shopify store data through GraphQL API.
auth_notes: Shopify uses OAuth, expiring offline tokens, HMAC webhook verification, minimal scopes, and per-store token isolation for authentication.

evidence.quote_snippet: To call a Shopify API, your code sends an access token in a request header to authenticate the identity that token represents (your app or a buyer) and authorize what that identity can access.
For any app with a backend of its own, authentication follows the same three steps: Your app gets an access token for the store it's calling.
With Environment Variables export SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN=your-access-token export SHOPIFY_DOMAIN=your-store.myshopify.com mcp-shopify
